simple.meaning: יָם (yâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “sea.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָם (H3221) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 7:2, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָם (H3221) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יָם (H3221) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יָם (yâm) / H3221 is traced through Daniel 7:2, Daniel 7:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.
